channel.title: What NBA players and coaches have said about Donovan Mitchell | HoopsMatic
channel.description: The latest quotes about Donovan Mitchell from NBA players, coaches and executives, with context and sources.

item.title: Sam Merrill on Donovan Mitchell
item.description:
Sam Merrill on Donovan Mitchell:

“Donovan’s always been 100% committed here. I remember when he signed his last extension, when everyone thought he was going to leave and there was questions about it, like that whole season I would make jokes about it to him because we can joke about that stuff. He’d always be like, ‘Is it not obvious?’ He felt like it was pretty clear that he was committed to Cleveland and he’s shown that again with this new extension. He really, really wants to be in Cleveland, loves it here, and really wants to win at the highest level.”

Sam Merrill on Donovan Mitchell, Oct 1, 2026. Source: YouTube.

item.title: Koby Altman on Donovan Mitchell
item.description:
Koby Altman on Donovan Mitchell:

“We added him and immediately become a must-see TV, prime time level team. He has turned into a MVP caliber player with us. His embrace of this organization and city is second to none. We hope to have his jersey hanging from the rafters.”

Koby Altman on Donovan Mitchell, Sep 25, 2026. Source: x.com.

item.title: Peyton Watson on Donovan Mitchell
item.description:
Peyton Watson on Donovan Mitchell:

“Since it's been announced that I was going to be a Cleveland Cavalier, he took the initiative to get to know me, to make me feel included, to invite me to pretty much everything he's done for the better part of this last monthor so of offseason. And it just shows the type of guy that he is, and I think that's something that I was really drawn to because I love to do that stuff. I love to get to know people, I love to know who I'm playing with, and he's just made it super easy bridging that gap.”

Peyton Watson on Donovan Mitchell, Sep 22, 2026. Source: YouTube.

item.title: Max Strus on Donovan Mitchell, Bam Adebayo
item.description:
Max Strus on Bam Adebayo:

“Me and Bam are tight. Bam’s awesome. That’s the last person I would want to mess with. Donovan Mitchell is a specimen but Bam Adebayo, holy sh*t. He’s a big dude.”

Max Strus on Donovan Mitchell, Bam Adebayo, Aug 23, 2026. Source: x.com.

item.title: Byron Scott on LeBron James, James Harden, Donovan Mitchell
item.description:
Byron Scott on LeBron James:

“If they didn't have James Harden, I think he would have did it a third time. But then again, we also heard reports that Donovan Mitchell wasn't a good fit with LeBron.”

Byron Scott on LeBron James, James Harden, Donovan Mitchell, Aug 3, 2026. Source: YouTube.

item.title: Vince Carter on Donovan Mitchell, Mikel Brown
item.description:
Vince Carter:

“Donovan Mitchell just got the bag… but he had high praises about you being the best freshman ever at Louisville. Like, what did that do for your confidence? Mikel Brown Jr.:”

Vince Carter on Donovan Mitchell, Mikel Brown, Jul 29, 2026. Source: Youtube.

item.title: Ryan Smith on Rudy Gobert, Donovan Mitchell
item.description:
Jazz owner Ryan Smith:

“I don't want to set expectations, but like we need to start winning. I think that's that's that's kind of where we're at. When we took over, I took over what was the number one team in the regular season and we got, I mean, it was interesting. My first day was like post-COVID. We were kind of into COVID and I had like two weeks to get a deal done with Rudy Gobert and Donovan Mitchell. It was really complicated because normally you have a long time to do this, but that team came out, we were number one in the regular season the first year and just got bounced early.”

Ryan Smith on Rudy Gobert, Donovan Mitchell, Jun 25, 2026. Source: YouTube.

item.title: Koby Altman on Donovan Mitchell
item.description:
With one year and a player option left on his current deal, Cavs president Koby Altman was asked about his status and a potential agreement, whether this summer or next offseason.

“Donovan has been steadfast in how much he loves it here, and so there hasn't been any question of will he be here and does he want to be here,”

Koby Altman on Donovan Mitchell, Jun 1, 2026. Source: Clutch Points.

item.title: Channing Frye on Jalen Brunson, Donovan Mitchell
item.description:
Channing Frye:

“You know the difference between Jalen Brunson and Donovan Mitchell is Brunson is a true number one. I do not think Donovan Mitchell is a true number one take you to the NBA Finals person. Do I think he is a great player? Yes. I think he is a two also. You have to bring a one in there, a real one.”

Channing Frye on Jalen Brunson, Donovan Mitchell, May 29, 2026. Source: YouTube.

item.title: Koby Altman on Donovan Mitchell
item.description:
When asked why he considers Mitchell an elite No. 1 player, Altman said,

“Donovan is uniquely ours and he's our guy. When you are constantly an All-NBA guy ... you embrace that.”

Koby Altman on Donovan Mitchell, May 29, 2026. Source: Akron Beacon Journal.

item.title: Kenny Atkinson on Donovan Mitchell
item.description:
Kenny Atkinson on Donovan Mitchell's groin strain:

“We don’t like soft tissue injuries ... the feedback I’m getting is that it’s not a long term thing.”

Kenny Atkinson on Donovan Mitchell, Feb 27, 2026. Source: x.com.

item.title: John Wall on Donovan Mitchell, Jarrett Allen, Darius Garland, Evan Mobley
item.description:
Oh No He Didn't: John Wall on the Cavs:

“I think they gotta make a big change. Donovan Mitchell, Darius Garland are just not getting along in that backcourtand I think with Jarrett Allen and Evan Mobley they're just too soft”

John Wall on Donovan Mitchell, Jarrett Allen, Darius Garland, Evan Mobley, Dec 27, 2025. Source: x.com.

item.title: Tyler Kolek on Donovan Mitchell
item.description:
Stefan Bondy:Tyler Kolek on his big block/swipe on Donovan Mitchell's breakaway in the final two minutes:

“Honestly if he ran and just did a regular lay-up, I wouldn’t have caught up to him. But he wanted to do some windmill s**tor. ..He slowed down, he was trying to do something crazy.”

Tyler Kolek on Donovan Mitchell, Dec 25, 2025. Source: Twitter.

item.title: Kentavious Caldwell-Pope on Donovan Mitchell, Tyrese Haliburton
item.description:
Kentavious Caldwell-Pope:

“But we’re talking about superstars. We’re talking about guys who get teams involved, elevate players, and when my team needs a win — they go get it. I can’t do that with Donovan Mitchell. And I’m 50/50 on Haliburton. He might average 25 and 8, but he’s not consistent. He’s clutch now, sure, but not consistent enough throughout the game. I need someone who shoots consistently, makes plays all game long. He’s getting there — but he’s not quite there yet.”

Kentavious Caldwell-Pope on Donovan Mitchell, Tyrese Haliburton, Jul 3, 2025. Source: YouTube.

item.title: Kenny Atkinson on Donovan Mitchell
item.description:
Dustin Dopirak:Kenny Atkinson on Donovan Mitchell:

“He's had to carry us, especially when we were short-handed and guys were out... We need to get him more support. We need our bench to step up like they have all year and they will.”

Kenny Atkinson on Donovan Mitchell, May 11, 2025. Source: Twitter @DustinDopirak.

item.title: Kenny Atkinson on Donovan Mitchell
item.description:
“Just for Donovan and really for our whole team, that was the most important thing in terms of getting ready for these playoffs was going into it healthy,”

Kenny Atkinson on Donovan Mitchell, Apr 17, 2025. Source: Cleveland Plain Dealer.

item.title: Kenny Atkinson on Donovan Mitchell, Darius Garland
item.description:
“A lot of it is the bench. We kind of know the main guys, Donovan and Darius, but we have Ty and Evan making 3s tonight. What I do like — a big part of it is we are generating great shots. Shot quality, I think we are 1 or 2 in the league.”

Kenny Atkinson on Donovan Mitchell, Darius Garland, Dec 6, 2024. Source: New York Times.

item.title: Ryan Smith on Rudy Gobert, Donovan Mitchell
item.description:
Ryan Smith was asked about how the Jazz came to lean into the youth movement this season, a key talking point from the team’s preseason media appearances.

“We made that decision when we traded Donovan [Mitchell] and Rudy [Gobert] and got those picks,”

Ryan Smith on Rudy Gobert, Donovan Mitchell, Oct 15, 2024. Source: KSL Sports.

item.title: Koby Altman on Donovan Mitchell
item.description:
Cleveland Cavaliers executive Koby Altman on re-signing Donovan Mitchell:

“Signing Donovan Mitchell to an extension serves as a pivotal moment for our franchise and reinforces our vision and goals for sustainable success. Donovan is one of the most dynamic All-NBA players in the league and we couldn’t be more excited that he chose Cleveland and this community to continue his basketball journey. We want to align ourselves with the best teams in the NBA and ultimately compete for championships, and we feel securing Donovan long-term provides us that opportunity.”

Koby Altman on Donovan Mitchell, Jul 7, 2024. Source: Twitter @MikeAScotto.

item.title: Udonis Haslem on Donovan Mitchell
item.description:
Udonis Haslem on Donovan Mitchell:

“I don't know if he's really interested in going back to Cleveland. I don't think Cleveland is his first choice. I think he might really want to get out of Cleveland. If you look back when he was traded to Cleveland, Cleveland wasn't even on his radar of teams where he wanted to go. It was New York. It was another team down south somewhere. I ain't going to say no names. But it was other teams that he was talking about going to. Cleveland was never on the list of teams that he wanted to go to in the first place.”

Udonis Haslem on Donovan Mitchell, Jun 20, 2024. Source: Sports Illustrated.

item.title: Koby Altman on Donovan Mitchell
item.description:
Cavaliers exec Koby Altman on a possible Donovan Mitchell extension:

“My exit interview with him was really good in that he was talking about the future and how excited he was about the team and organization… From his own words, he says he’s happy and likes it here.”

Koby Altman on Donovan Mitchell, May 24, 2024. Source: Twitter @MikeAScotto.

item.title: Charles Barkley on Stephen A. Smith, Donovan Mitchell
item.description:
Barkley said on The Bickley and Marotta Show.

“Last few years, it’s been Donovan Mitchell. Last time … KD was a free agent it was New York. Stephen A is a friend of mine, and I love Stephen A, but he wants everyone in New York. He’s not going to die happy until the Knicks win a championship. … You can skip that (rumor).”

Charles Barkley on Stephen A. Smith, Donovan Mitchell, Apr 30, 2024. Source: Arizona Republic.

item.title: JB Bickerstaff on Donovan Mitchell
item.description:
#Cavs J.B. Bickerstaff on why they don't just shut down Donovan Mitchell:

“This has been a conversation between myself, him and our medical staff. It's the thing that we're most comfortable with. He knows his body more than anybody. He feels like he needs the reps.”

JB Bickerstaff on Donovan Mitchell, Apr 7, 2024. Source: Twitter @ChrisFedor.

item.title: Georges Niang on Donovan Mitchell
item.description:
First,Niang said on Ryen Russillo’s podcast:

“From the vibes I get around here and from when I was with (Mitchell in Utah) and the experiences over there, I would lean towards (Mitchell) being a Cavalier for a long time. That’s just my personal thought. That has nothing to do with what he’s going to do because he’s his own person, but I think he genuinely enjoys this organization, the situation that he’s in, how it can continue to help grow his career and how it can affect his ability to win.”

Georges Niang on Donovan Mitchell, Mar 30, 2024. Source: The Athletic.

item.title: Thanasis Antetokounmpo on Donovan Mitchell
item.description:
Thanasis Antetokounmpo:

“People ask me, 'How do you get Donovan Mitchell, how do you get all these people do your pod?' They told me 'yes,' because know what kind of person I am. I don't care about the viral stuff. And that's why my podcast has grown organically, because it's not about being viral. It's not about having sound bites. It's honest conversation. It's me and learning the culture, the U.S., and a lot of things that people would assume that I know but I don't know.”

Thanasis Antetokounmpo on Donovan Mitchell, Mar 12, 2024. Source: Milwaukee Journal-Sentinel.

item.title: Paul Pierce on Donovan Mitchell
item.description:
On the ‘KG Certified’ podcast, ‘The Truth’ discussed the factors influencing Mitchell’s decision not to sign an extension with the Cavs.

“I'm not sure Donovan is happy over there. For one, I don’t think – he’s not signing an extension there,”

Paul Pierce on Donovan Mitchell, Oct 24, 2023. Source: MSN.

item.title: Jalen Brunson on Donovan Mitchell
item.description:
“There’s always possibilities when you hear about that stuff. Donovan is a good friend of mine for a while. We were in the same high school class, our relationship goes back a long way. I think right now, I’m more than happy with my guys, and I love my teammates.”

Jalen Brunson on Donovan Mitchell, Aug 11, 2023. Source: The Athletic.

item.title: Tim Bontemps on Donovan Mitchell
item.description:
“I don’t think there’s any chance he signs an extension there ever, and if it was up to me I would trade Donovan Mitchell today,”

Tim Bontemps on Donovan Mitchell, Jul 25, 2023. Source: New York Post.

item.title: JB Bickerstaff on Donovan Mitchell
item.description:
Kelsey Russo:#Cavs J.B. Bickerstaff on what he expects from Donovan Mitchell tonight:

“I expect him to lead us and I expect him to do and show us whatever's necessary for us to get a win [...] I expect him to defend and lay it all out there. He will not go out with anything left in his tank.”

JB Bickerstaff on Donovan Mitchell, Apr 26, 2023. Source: Twitter @kelseyyrusso.

item.title: Patrick Williams on Donovan Mitchell
item.description:
Julia Poe:Patrick Williams on the missed box-out on Donovan Mitchell in Monday's loss:

“It was definitely a tough position to put the ref in, but I gotta get the rebound.”

Patrick Williams on Donovan Mitchell, Jan 4, 2023. Source: Twitter @byjuliapoe.
